title: Cell SQL expressions and type values · dark
brief: Data-grid cell as a SQL expression (S2), Set to default staged as an expression (S3), driver-supplied Set to type value and Set to expression… (S4). PostgreSQL public.loan_approvals; Bolt Byzantium islands look, dark theme. Two directions: everything from a Set value submenu, or an inline literal/expression editor with a type-value suggestion list.

artboards.title: Set value submenu from the cell context menu
artboards.tradeoff: All new actions in one discoverable submenu, each with a key; one extra menu level and a longer path to a free-form expression.

artboards.title: Inline editor with literal/expression toggle
artboards.tradeoff: Short menu and one place to edit; type values are only discoverable once the editor is open, and the toggle adds a mode to learn.
